SELECT 
    t2.patownerref,
    MAX(t1.timemark) AS latest_assessment_time
FROM 
    encounters AS t1
JOIN 
    assessmentbasics AS t2 ON t1.abref = t2.abkey
GROUP BY 
    t2.patownerref;

SELECT 
    t2.patownerref,
    t3.suicrisk,
    t3.subuse,
    t3.subusefreq,
    t3.subusesev,
    t3.mental_health_scores
FROM 
    encounters AS t1
JOIN 
    assessmentbasics AS t2 ON t1.abref = t2.abkey
JOIN 
    assessmentsymptomsandrisk AS t3 ON t2.abkey = t3.asrkey
WHERE (
    t2.patownerref, t1.timemark
) IN (
    SELECT 
        patownerref, MAX(timemark)
    FROM 
        encounters
    JOIN 
        assessmentbasics ON encounters.abref = assessmentbasics.abkey
    GROUP BY 
        patownerref
);
